maria: Heads-up - saw GPU pool in us-west-2 spike ~3x for ~7m during the 03:00 job window. Some routes started getting rejected by the old admission code. I want to propose we move to a hybrid throttle mode: bounded queue + best-effort degrade (model downshift / quantized path) before reject. Thoughts?
ajay: +1 to hybrid. Rejects cause bad UX, but unlimited queueing blows our tail latency. Need a clear SLO for max wait time. Also how do we prevent thundering herd when queue drains?
sam_k: Agree on queue cap. Suggest cost units for admission: cost = tokens * model_weight. Keep per-region tokens_in_flight <= capacity. If inbound would exceed cap -> try degrade (model_small, 8-bit), else enqueue if wait_estimate<200ms, else reject.
maria: That matches my thinking. For degrade options: fallback to quantized model in same pod (fast) or shorter generation length via server-side heuristic. Add response header `x-redwood-degraded: reason` so clients can see.
claire: Billing question: if we degrade, do we bill at original model price or degraded price? We should bill at actual compute consumed and tag events for reconciliation.
ajay: Implementation notes: admission controller needs cheap estimate of runtime. We can use precomputed model compute_factors and multiply by expected_tokens (max_tokens param). Also track KV cache hits—cached prefixes should reduce cost. Pseudocode:
``
units = model_factor[model] * max_tokens
if units + region_usage > region_capacity:
  if can_degrade_to(model_small): return DEGRADE
  elif queue_estimate < max_wait_ms: enqueue
  else: return REJECT
```

maria: Agree. Also add circuit-breaker to avoid constant degrade oscillation (cooldown windows). Monitor degrade->reject cascade.
infra-bot: metric alert: us-west-2 gpu-utilization 92% at 03:04 UTC, queue_length spike 420 -> triggered 5% reject rate
sam_k: Metrics to track in rollout: p95 latency, p99 tail latency, degrade_rate, reject_rate, queue_time_p95, customer_error_rate, cost_per_1k_tokens. We'll also tag by model and by customer_tier.
maria: Rollout plan: 1) observer mode (record decisions but don't enforce) for 48h; 2) soft-degrade with headers for next 72h (opt-out flag); 3) enforce with bounded queue + reject. Feature flags + runbook + revert plan. I'll open PR for FH and a dashboard.
ajay: One more: network stragglers can stall queue drain. Add per-request timeout and per-pod stall detector to force early degrade.
maria: Thanks. I'll sync with @claire on billing mapping and @eng-sre for runbook. Will post the draft PR link here.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 (draft) - contains controller, metrics, and flag
claire: Reviewed the billing sketch; fine to bill actual compute. Need legal to OK customer TOS change for degraded responses.
maria: OK will loop legal. Thx everyone :thumbsup:
